items.title: ESDS Software extends rally, hits 20% upper band a day after bumper listing
items.description: ESDS Software Services shares were listed on Friday at a premium of 76 per cent and soon extended gains to trade over 100 per cent higher.

items.title: Pranav Constructions IPO bags 'subscribe' tag from experts; here's why
items.description: Pranav Constructions IPO: Analysts have assigned a 'subscribe' tag to the offer based on its scalable business model, strong brand positioning, and high entry barriers in redevelopment.

items.title: Udaan buys Swiggy's LYNK for ₹500 cr as e-commerce firm readies for IPO
items.description: As part of the transaction, Swiggy will acquire about a 2.8 per cent stake in Udaan and invest Rs 75 crore in parent entity TIPL for an additional 0.4 per cent stake
